excalidraw.error.changed: The drawing changed. Inspect it again before editing.
excalidraw.error.conflict: The drawing changed on disk. Your draft is preserved. Save a copy or resolve the external change before retrying.
excalidraw.error.discard: Discard the preserved draft and reload the current file from disk? This cannot be undone.
excalidraw.error.invalid: Invalid Excalidraw drawing. The original file has not been changed.
excalidraw.error.loading: The drawing editor is still loading.
excalidraw.error.missing: The drawing file no longer exists.
excalidraw.error.save: Could not save the drawing. Your draft is preserved.
excalidraw.error.svg: This SVG has no valid embedded Excalidraw scene. Export it with embedded scene data to edit it.
excalidraw.property.native: Use the drawing editor’s controls to edit the selected elements.
manifest.description: Excalidraw whiteboard for .excalidraw, .excalidraw.json and editable .excalidraw.svg files: freehand drawing, shapes, arrows and text on an infinite canvas. Embed drawings in notes with an excalidraw code block, and link elements to notes with [[wikilinks]].
manifest.name: Excalidraw
